meta.homeTitle: Dairy Classic | Wholesale Ice Cream Maker in Uzbekistan
meta.homeDescription: Dairy Classic has been making delicious, high-quality ice cream in Tashkent since 1996. We make 44 kinds of cones, sticks, cups, biscuits, and family tubs for shops and families across Uzbekistan.

hero.eyebrow: Made in Tashkent Since 1996 · Ice Cream Maker & Wholesale Supplier
hero.sub: Delicious, creamy ice cream made with fresh milk and natural ingredients for over 30 years.

footer.tagline: Making delicious, high-quality ice cream with fresh milk in Tashkent since 1996.

thirty.title: 30 Years of Dairy Classic
thirty.body: Since 1996, we have been making fresh, tasty ice cream for everyone. We use 100% real milk, pure chocolate, and natural ingredients in every product. For 30 years, our goal has been simple: to bring joy and great taste to families across Uzbekistan.

wheel.title: Find your flavour
wheel.instruction: Drag the wheel, tap a mood or press Spin.
wheel.label: Flavour wheel. Use the arrow keys to change mood.

taglines.cones: Crispy waffle cones filled with rich ice cream and chocolate.
taglines.sticks: Ice cream bars dipped in thick chocolate and crunchy nuts.
taglines.cups: Classic ice cream cups for a quick, sweet treat anytime.
taglines.biscuit: Soft biscuits with cool, creamy ice cream in the middle.
taglines.tubs: Large family tubs perfect for sharing at home.
taglines.cassatta: Delicious multi-layer ice cream cakes for celebrations.

fresh.title: Our Newest Ice Creams
fresh.sub: Try our latest ice cream bars, freshly made with new flavours and rich toppings.

fresh-milk-process.title: How We Make Ice Cream with 100% Real Fresh Milk
fresh-milk-process.excerpt: A behind-the-scenes look inside our modern Tashkent plant, where fresh morning milk is churned into delicious, creamy ice cream.

chocolate-crunch-secret.title: The Art of the Crunch: Pure Chocolate & Roasted Peanuts
chocolate-crunch-secret.excerpt: Discover why real cocoa butter and freshly roasted peanuts give our SuperChoc, Vega, and Sandwich their signature crisp bite.

thirty-years-tashkent.title: 30 Years of Sweet Memories Across Uzbekistan
thirty-years-tashkent.excerpt: From our very first vanilla cone in 1996 to 44 favourites today — the story of Uzbekistan's beloved family ice cream maker.

recipes.title: Quick Desserts You Can Make at Home

creamica-milkshake.title: Creamica Vanilla Milkshake
creamica-milkshake.description: Blend Creamica Vanilla ice cream with cold milk for an easy, thick and creamy milkshake.

cassatta-party-slices.title: Cassatta Ice Cream Slices
cassatta-party-slices.description: Cut cold Classic Cassatta into neat slices and sprinkle with roasted peanuts for a quick party treat.

super-vanilla-affogato.title: Super Vanilla Coffee Float
super-vanilla-affogato.description: Add a scoop of Super Vanilla ice cream to a cup of warm coffee for a quick, delicious dessert.
